title: Sludge-derived hydrochar as a potential electrocatalyst for improved CO2 reduction in microbial electrosynthesis
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00523F, Paper

Lakshmi Pathi Thulluru, Anil Dhanda, Manikanta M. Doki, Makarand M. Ghangrekar, Shamik Chowdhury
The potential application of hydrochar derived from anaerobic and alum sludge as a cathode catalyst for CO2 bioreduction is being explored for the first time in microbial electrosynthesis.
